title: This Past Week in Golf: Rahm Wins, Blades Brown at 19, Frost Delay Layers
excerpt: Jon Rahm wins Abu Dhabi, Blades Brown becomes the youngest PGA Tour winner since 1931, LIV Golf winds down, and how to layer up for a frost delay round.
image_alt: A man in the Rhone Voyage Down Vest in Black over a dark knit
intro: Jon Rahm wins in his first start after LIV, a 19-year-old wins in Cabo, and LIV Golf is winding down. Plus how to dress for a cold November round.
highlights: Blades Brown, 19, won in Cabo to become the youngest PGA Tour winner since 1931.
Jon Rahm won the Abu Dhabi Championship in his first start after LIV, and LIV Golf confirmed it will close.
A three-layer system for frost delay golf: a knit, a down vest and a jacket you shed by the 4th hole.

sections.heading: How to play the frost delay
paragraphs: A cold round can be the best one of the year. Mostly it comes down to what you wear.

There's a version of November golf that's miserable, and a version that's the best round of the year. The difference is mostly what you wear. Start with a knit you can swing in. Add a down vest for the first tee. Bring a jacket you can shed by the 4th hole, and keep a towel in the bag for wet grips.
That's the whole system. Three layers, one towel, and a thermos if you have one. Here's what we'd pack, plus everything that happened in golf this week.
Dress for the first tee. Shed it by the 4th.
Photo at top: [Rhone Voyage Down Vest](/shop/rhone-voyage-down-vest) in Black. Photo: Rhone.

sections.heading: The outer layer
paragraphs: Four pieces for a 40-degree tee time, in the order you'd put them on.

The base: the [Rhone Back Nine Knit Polo](/shop/rhone-back-nine-knit-polo) in Toasted Oat, a midweight jacquard knit. It feels like a sweater you've owned for years and swings like a polo. The Johnny collar gives it a retro look that works just as well at dinner.

The warmth: the [Rhone Voyage Down Vest](/shop/rhone-voyage-down-vest) in Black, with 700+ fill down. Real insulation without the bulk. Bonded fill zones, a water-resistant finish and all-way stretch, so your arms stay free through the swing.

The shell: the [Rhone Long Game Jacket](/shop/rhone-long-game-jacket) in Pure Black, in Pursuit stretch fabric. The layer you start in and take off by the 4th hole. Classic fit, full stretch, and light enough to tie around the bag.

The one you'll forget: the [Winston Golf Tour Towel](/shop/winston-golf-tour-towel) in White with Green Stripes, in ribbed terry. Cold mornings mean wet grips and wet balls. A full 22 by 44 inch tour towel handles both, and it doubles as the leaf rake in the rule below.
Rather wear merino? The [Olydoe Merino Ponte Vest](/shop/olydoe-merino-ponte-vest) does the same job in a knit.

sections.heading: Five things from the week
paragraphs: Rahm wins in his first start after LIV. Jon Rahm shot 67 on Sunday to win the Abu Dhabi Championship at 23 under, two clear of Tyrrell Hatton and four ahead of Rory McIlroy. It's his first European tour title in four years. Via [AP](https://apnews.com/article/golf-abu-dhabi-rahm-mcilroy-hatton-dp-world-04145781e19f044454843a05d1717788).

Blades Brown, 19, wins in Cabo. He started Sunday seven back, shot 63 and beat Ben James on the second playoff hole. That makes him the youngest PGA Tour winner since 1931. Via [CBC Sports](https://cbc.ca/sports/golf/teen-blades-brown-wins-world-wide-technology-championship-9.7414521).

LIV Golf is winding down. The league confirmed in bankruptcy court that it will close after five seasons. Its players are already showing up on the DP World Tour. Via [GOLF.com](https://golf.com/news/liv-golf-dp-world-tour/).

McIlroy ties Monty. Rory McIlroy shot a bogey-free 67 on Sunday to overtake Eugenio Chacarra and win his eighth Race to Dubai, tying Colin Montgomerie's record. Tyrrell Hatton won the tournament itself by five. Via the [DP World Tour](https://www.europeantour.com/dpworld-tour/news/articles/detail/rory-mcilroy-wins-eighth-race-to-dubai-after-final-day-thriller/).

The first Austin Championship. At Omni Barton Creek, Trace Crowe, who opened with a course-record 62, holed a bunker shot on 17 on Saturday and took a one-shot lead into the final round on November 15, chasing his first win. Via the [PGA Tour](https://www.pgatour.com/article/news/daily-wrapup/2026/11/14/round-3-austin-championship-recap-fazio-canyons-course-scores-leaderboard-results).

sections.heading: The leaf rule, revisited
paragraphs: Every November someone in your group swears there's a free drop for a ball lost in the leaves. There is, sometimes. Here's the whole rule in three steps.
Move the leaves. Leaves are loose impediments. You can clear them anywhere, even in a bunker or penalty area. Hands, towel, hat: all fine.
Don't move the ball. If the ball moves while you clear leaves, it's one penalty stroke and you put it back. On the green, there's no penalty.
Ask about F-14. Lost it in a pile? Free relief only if the course has Model Local Rule F-14 in effect. Otherwise it's stroke and distance.
Rules via the [USGA Rules Guide to Fall Golf](https://www.usga.org/content/usga/home-page/articles/2024/10/rule_guide_fall_golf.html).

sections.heading: The Open goes back to Carnoustie
paragraphs: The R&A announced on November 9 that the 2029 Open will be played at Carnoustie, its ninth Open and the first since Francesco Molinari won there in 2018. Carnoustie has a reputation as the toughest course on the rota, and nobody learned why better than Jean Van de Velde. In 1999 he stood on the 18th tee with a three-shot lead and needed only a double bogey to win.
What followed was a driver, a 2-iron off the grandstand, a trip into the Barry Burn with his trousers rolled up, and a playoff loss to Paul Lawrie. It's still the most famous hole in Open history.
[Watch the 18th at Carnoustie, 1999](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LnUaMCKPNxM)
Announcement via the [PGA Tour](https://www.pgatour.com/article/news/latest/2026/11/09/carnoustie-to-host-2029-the-open-championship). Video: ABC Sports on YouTube.

paragraphs: Frost on the greens, a heater in the cart, a buddy who quit at the turn. Get the Mully Letter, reply to any issue, and tell us the temperature and the course. A few sentences is plenty.
